claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if a later AAOI filing cancels the agreement, materially reduces the cleanroom scope, or pushes substantial completion beyond January 10, 2027. The filing does not prove product allocation, qualified output, utilization, or shipment volume.
claims.statement: AAOI entered a $94.1 million design-build agreement for its OMD 3 (FAB4) project, including approximately 195,591 square feet of ISO Class 6 cleanroom space, with targeted substantial completion on January 10, 2027.

sources.quote: OMD 3 (FAB4) cleanroom construction project located at 11555 North Spectrum Blvd., Houston, Texas 77047
